t: Section 1113(d) of the Social Security Act is amended by striking out “1968” and inserting in lieu thereof “1969”.

fable.w: This section only changes a date in an existing statute, extending a deadline by one year. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government, so there is no real tempting contrary reading.
fable.s: Section 1113(d) of the Social Security Act is amended by striking out “1968” and inserting in lieu thereof “1969”.
